summary: REPAIR V3-05 accepted: atomic completion is now a single transactional operation. completeTodoAtomic validates via planTodoCompletion then runs repos.withTransaction wrapping todos.update + contributions.create; RepositoryFactory provides SQLite withTransactionAsync and in-memory snapshot/restore equivalence; UI handleComplete calls the atomic use-case instead of Promise.all; four failure-injection tests prove (a) todo-update failure creates 0 contributions and leaves todo active, (b) contribution-create failure rolls back todo to 'todo', (c) retry after either failure yields exactly one ContributionEntry and ledger zero-sum. Trusted verification exit 0 reproduced (typecheck, 200 tests, Expo export/prebuild/native debug BUILD SUCCESSFUL). No V3-01..V3-04 regression, no chrono/premium/paywall, no domain Firebase coupling.
checks: trusted verification exit 0 reproduced: typecheck + 200 tests (15 suites) + Expo export Android (1309 modules) + prebuild + native debug BUILD SUCCESSFUL
completeTodoAtomic use-case exists and wraps both writes in repos.withTransaction

no chrono reintroduction: grep ChronoTimer/startChrono/stopChrono clean except migration docs
no Premium/paywall/entitlement/billing in product code: grep clean across app/src
no Firebase/Firestore types in domain or application use-case: grep clean
V3-01..V3-04 regressions green: ledgers, property invariants, materialized balances, pagination, V3-03/V3-04 cost gates all pass
offline coherence preserved: local-first transactional write, data-change signals emitted after commit, honest notification/calendar ports still gated by isAvailable()

findings.problem: In-memory withTransaction snapshots only todos and contributions; if future coupled operations span other repos they would need additional snapshots. For current V3-05 scope this is correct and explicitly documented.
findings.evidence: withTransaction snapshots todoRepo and contributionRepo only; no other repo mutated inside the transaction. Future V3-06 sync queueing will need to extend if needed.
findings.requiredFix: No fix required for V3-05. Document that extension point if additional atomic couplings are added later.
findings.verification: Manual inspection; all V3-05 completion paths only touch todos and contributions.
